text:
maya: Quick UX pass on the priority ladder in routing editor. With large rule sets it's hard to tell WHY a rule won or lost  want to propose a few lightweight changes before the next release.

jordan: Agree. Main gaps: lack of tie-breaker visibility, noisy error language, and reorder affordances aren't keyboard-friendly.

sam: Copy idea: replace blunt 'Invalid' with tiered labels: 'Info: no matches', 'Warning: possible overlap', 'Conflict: mutually exclusive' so severity is clearer. Each label can have an inline 'why?' that opens a small focused panel.

taylor: Simulator control: move Run into the preview header and surface a small dropdown to pick Live vs Snapshot mode. Also add a tiny history icon so users can revert previous sim runs.

lee: A11Y bits: drag handle contrast is low. Quick CSS suggestion: ```css
.rule-handle{ color:#41474a }
.rule-handle:focus-visible{ box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(10,132,255,0.25); outline:none }
``` Also implement keyboard grab: Space to grab, Up/Down to move, Space to drop. Use `aria-grabbed` while moving and announce progress via a polite live region.

design-bot: Checklist saved: severity badges, tie-breaker tooltip (created-at/id), relocated simulator, grab/keyboard reorder + aria-grabbed announcements, soften copy, preview live-region.

maya: I'll mock a compact ladder view with sticky priority column and a focused 'why?' flyout for label explanations. ETA: Tuesday AM. If no objections I'll include keyboard demo HTML for the grab flow.

jordan: Nice plan. Please include the focus/state styles and a sample of the new label copy in the mock so PMs can sign off quickly. :thumbsup:
